major_issues.issue: 审核范围要求下,'total oxygenated taxane titers were improved twofold to 78 mg/L (Conclusion p.14)' vs 摘要中'2.7-fold to 78 mg/L'存在原文内部不一致；草稿在结论部分以'2.4–2.7 倍提升'同时呈现两数，但正文别处反复仅引'78 mg/L（2.4 倍）'或'78 mg/L（2.7 倍）'，未一贯注明这是原文自相矛盾
major_issues.source_locator: Abstract p.2 'Total oxygenated taxane titers were improved 2.7-fold at this scale to 78 mg/L' vs Conclusion p.14 'Total oxygenated taxane titers were improved twofold to 78 mg/L ... oxygenated taxane titer was also improved 2.4-fold to 78 mg/L'
major_issues.correction: 在六、总体结论中应明确指出原文内部对'78 mg/L vs Zhou 2015 (33 mg/L)'的倍数提法不一致（2.4 倍 / 2.7 倍），并标注差异源自原文

minor_issues.issue: 报告中'作者据此推测该 P450 在真核膜环境下的构象或底物通道与原核体系存在差异，但缺乏结构生物学证据'为解读者推断，原文仅说'when expressed in E. coli, OCT and iso-OCT were previously found to be the major products of CYP725A4 (Edgar et al., 2016)... however, a novel oxygenated diterpenoid... was the major product'，未直接提出构象/底物通道差异
minor_issues.source_locator: 正文 3.2 节 / Results and Discussion
minor_issues.correction: 应改为'作者将该差异归因于宿主环境，但未提供机制层面证据'，删除'构象或底物通道'的推断性表述

minor_issues.issue: '1.06 和 2.5-fold 提升' 后单位沿用原文 '137 ± 5  g/L' (原文摘要/Conclusion), 显然应为 mg/L 但原刊未改
minor_issues.correction: 可保留原文表述但建议加注'原文摘要与结论中单位标作 g/L，按 Figure 5 与 Nowrouzi 比较应为 mg/L'
